title: Asymmetric token ladder with streaming grace credits for hosted API
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Summary: Run an A/B experiment that evaluates asymmetric input (ingress) vs output (egress) per-token rates plus a small pool of free streaming grace credits per API key to reduce impact on interactive UIs. Goals: 1) quantify demand elasticity for input-heavy vs output-heavy workloads; 2) estimate revenue impact and churn risk for adding a monthly minimum/commit; 3) validate enterprise contract language to support asymmetric pricing and minimums. This ticket coordinates PM, Eng, Finance, Legal, and Solutions. Outcome will recommend a two-arm pricing probe with instrumentation, dashboarding, and a legal template for enterprise SOWs.
